aboutSection.title: ABOUT US
aboutSection.description: Welcome to Dosa World, Hamburg's premier destination for authentic South Indian cuisine. We specialize in crafting delicious dosas, idlis, and other traditional dishes, all made with fresh ingredients and aromatic spices. Experience the vibrant flavors of South India in every bite at Dosa World.

menuSection.title: OUR MENU
menuSection.description: Dosa World offers a variety of South Indian dishes, including crispy dosas, flavorful biryanis, and refreshing drinks like mango lassi. Don't miss our specialty Masala Dosa and tangy Sambar. Explore our full menu by visiting the menu page.

reservationSection.title: RESERVATIONS
reservationSection.description: Reserve your table at Dosa World with ease using our online reservation feature. Book in advance and enjoy a seamless dining experience at Hamburg’s top South Indian restaurant.

aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.paragraph1: Welcome to Dosa World, where South Indian flavors come alive in Hamburg. Our menu features everything from crispy dosas and soft idlis to aromatic biryanis.
aboutPage.paragraph2: At Dosa World, we're dedicated to delivering an authentic and memorable dining experience. Each dish is a celebration of South Indian heritage.
